text:
# V1.12.2

Section: Source

**V1.12.2** of *[Stormworks: Build and Rescue](https://stormworks.fandom.com/wiki/Stormworks:_Build_and_Rescue)* was released on September 11th, 2024.

# V1.12.2

Bug Fixes & New Features Include the following

## Features

- Flow rate logic node for pump and valve components

## Reworks

- 2450# Doors are now interactable from a seat

## Fixes

- Regular rx components tagged as DLC only

- 24725# Vehicle editor budget label not updating with undo/redo

- 24899# Reconnecting peer's network id, flashlight and audio data not rebuilt correctly

- 25100# JSI fuel pumps havering above floor

## Balances

- 25065# Reduced volume and balanced range of fluid pump sfx

## Source

- [Steam Community News](https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/573090/view/4597700946277050545?l=english)
